rule.nine: Sheriff and Thief play the following game. Nine cards numbered 1, 2, …, {{cardCount}} are on the table. Sheriff and Thief alternate picking up cards, with the Sheriff going first. The Thief wins if they collect three cards where one number is the average of the other two. The Sheriff wins if the Thief fails to collect such a triple.
rule.seven:
Sheriff and Thief play the following game. Seven cards numbered 1, 2, …, {{cardCount}} are on the table. The game lasts {{cardCount}} turns; on each turn one player picks up a card. The turn order is:
1. Sheriff, 2. Thief, 3. Sheriff, 4. Thief, 5. Sheriff, 6. Thief, 7. Thief.
The Thief wins if they collect three cards where one number is the average of the other two. The Sheriff wins if the Thief fails to collect such a triple.
